title: Genesis Block Wallet Puzzle

author.name: anonymous (on-chain only, OP_RETURN messages to the escrow)

prize.note: 37 P2WSH outputs to one witness script; the jackpot grows because the author relays every paid question into the escrow (125,779 sats on 2026-08-24, 142,779 on 2026-08-29, 168,779 on 2026-09-12, 229,724 on 2026-09-17)

target_format: P2WSH v0; witness script OP_2 <keyA> <keyB> OP_2 OP_CHECKMULTISIG; both keys derived from genesis data through a 12-word BIP39 mnemonic whose entropy is a 128-bit digest, with a name as passphrase, along BIP48 m/48'/0'/account'/script_type' with a genesis value as account

derivation.summary: build a 12-word BIP39 mnemonic from a 128-bit digest of genesis data, add the passphrase (the name of whoever received the first transaction, in an undisclosed format), derive along BIP48 m/48'/0'/account'/script_type' with a genesis value as account, build the 2-of-2 witness script in either key order, sha256 it, and compare with the published 32-byte witness program
derivation.certified_against: the BIP-173 P2WSH test vector, and a real 2-of-2 P2WSH spent in block 963629 (tx 47ded3504e855ce418e46eeca4694b55a623d1e23a8e3c83292abbcf9cee9f7a, input 0) whose revealed keys rebuild the script and hash to the spent address; private key 1 to the generator point; negative control against the escrow

difficulty_note: the lock is fully characterized (2-of-2 P2WSH, exact offline oracle) and the corpus is 285 public bytes; passes 1 and 2 (2026-08-29) exhausted the mechanical readings of the August hints, pass 3 (2026-09-12) killed the raw 16-byte window model, and the author confirmed on 2026-09-15 that the entropy is not the raw 16 bytes but a 128-bit digest and that the passphrase is a name, the name of whoever received the first transaction; pass 4 (2026-09-17, three waves, 8.03e9 ordered pairs over 6,078 digest entropies and up to 137 name formats, witnesses re-found) shows the digest input is none of the 73 canonical genesis readings nor of 300 typed forms of the texts; the author answered the question that asks which input is hashed with a joke about refreshing his memory, which reads as a request for a larger payment

leads.title: read the author's answer to the unanswered on-chain question of 2026-09-17 about which input is hashed into the 128-bit entropy
ask the author on chain which 128-bit digest function and which genesis bytes (76-byte draft in the README)
pass 5 once the digest input is named: enumerate the name formats and the BIP48 paths against it
widen the digest inputs beyond the typed forms killed in wave 3: concatenated fields, other file encodings, digest functions outside the 18 tested
watch the escrow for new OP_RETURN hints or a spend before any work
pass 4: 128-bit digest entropies with name passphrases, three waves (canonical inputs, two-cosigner pairing, typed inputs and cross-passphrase pairing), 8.03e9 pairs
pass 3: 16-byte genesis windows as 12-word entropy, 53 passphrases, genesis integers as BIP48 account, script types 0/1/2, keys paired (2.46e12 pairs)
pass 2: library-specific roots (hashed roots, raw 64-byte extended key, raw key with zero chain code) along the same 214 paths
pass 1: literal readings of the 2026-08-28 hints, families A to D
